title: strip_did_sig_header: per-line lowercase alloc
description: strip_did_sig_header in did_verify.rs calls to_ascii_lowercase() on each line of the article, allocating a new String per line, to perform the header name comparison. A typical article has 10-20 header lines. These allocations are unnecessary: the comparison can be done case-insensitively on byte slices without allocating (e.g. using a byte-slice starts_with after lowercasing only the prefix-length prefix, or using the unicase/ascii crate). Additionally, the function allocates a Vec<&str> for all lines and then joins them back with String::join, producing two full article-sized allocations for what is essentially a filter-and-copy. At low POST rates this is negligible; at transit-node burst rates (hundreds of articles/minute) the GC pressure accumulates. A byte-walking implementation that copies lines selectively would reduce to one output Vec<u8> allocation.
